topic: Verification of ISS-2447 (-29.1→-28.9 nT) and ISS-2448 (inject_ai_layer unverified note) in §6.14

holes_found.description: Cross-section residual after ISS-2447 fix: part5 kill-shot still lists -29.1 as one of three inconsistent dome values ('the dome\'s own documents as three inconsistent values — −17 to −21, −28.9, and −29.1 nT'). With ISS-2447 establishing that monitor.py\'s formula gives −28.9 (not −29.1) for the Ebro 2026 prediction, the part5 text\'s attribution of −29.1 to dome documents for the same prediction may now be inaccurate. If −29.1 was our own prior misattribution (as OUR sections §4.4/§6.10/§9.1 previously stated, per ISS-2447 description), then part5\'s claim that 'dome documents' show this value needs sourcing. Alternatively, if the dome independently published −29.1 somewhere (e.g., a prior monitor.py output or an older predictions page), the part5 text is correct. The predictions.json PRED-095 passage ('the dome\'s monitor.py already showed a −29.1 nT value for a prior eclipse') may be the source — but that refers to a DIFFERENT eclipse, not the August 2026 Ebro prediction. Narrow scope: cannot resolve cross-section sourcing question; flagging for decider to verify whether the dome\'s own August 2026 materials ever showed −29.1 specifically, or whether part5\'s three-value enumeration predates the ISS-2447 discovery and needs a targeted update. Two occurrences in sections.json part5 at ~bytes 398074 and 400172.
holes_found.recommendation: Decider: open a new minor ISS for part5 §6.14-kill-shot consistency check. Two options: (A) verify the dome\'s own predictions page or monitor.py historically showed −29.1 for August 2026 Ebro (if so, part5 is accurate and a footnote suffices); (B) if −29.1 was purely our internal error, replace both part5 occurrences to match the corrected §6.14 framing: 'three inconsistent values — −17 to −21, ~−28.9 (monitor.py KAPPA-squared formula), and ~−8.4 (inject_ai_layer.py BOU-family variant) nT' (or similar three-formula enumeration). Not blocking — part5 kill-shot conclusion is unaffected by which of the three dome values is cited.

summary_for_decider: ISS-2447 and ISS-2448 patches confirmed landed in §6.14 and part9. −29.1 is gone from both sections; −28.9 formula value is consistent across §6.14 TLDR, §6.14 formula paragraph, and part9. inject_ai_layer.py unverified-per-cycle note correctly inserted. ONE MINOR NEW FINDING: part5 kill-shot still references both −28.9 and −29.1 as 'dome\'s own document' values for the August 2026 Ebro prediction. With §6.14 now establishing −28.9 as the authoritative monitor.py output, the source of −29.1 in the part5 kill-shot needs a decider check — it may be a pre-ISS-2447 stale reference or legitimately from a different dome document. Recommend opening a new minor ISS. qid=454 can otherwise close.
